??? quote "Dialogue"

    - Come in, sit. The Brenna host every choosing, *Player*, and I have hosted two, so I am very good at telling people to sit. Tea?
    - The Edgewood is quieter, and my letters can go east. I have written to the same friend in Fairy Forest every spring since my envoy days. Neither of us has missed a year.
    - Corwell will send my letter with the next caravan east. It will be slow; caravans are slow now. My friend will forgive it. We are both old enough to know that letters arrive when they arrive.
    - Rimwort from the far slopes again. Lessa nearly smiled. I keep the old forest-herb lore, but this herb is ours: grey, bitter, and good for what bites.
    - I told Ahvi to sing it. The bites, the goats, the gnawers, the dry springs, Imre's dates: all of it in front of me, and a verse that says the beasts grew wild before the Burning. What it means, the families must decide together. That is what a gathering is for.
    - Now. What can I do for you?
        - *Choice:* Who are you?
        - *Choice:* What do you think of the Old One?
        - *Choice:* How do you keep four families at peace?
        - *Choice:* Goodbye.
    - Odda, chieftain of the Brenna these twenty years. Healer's mother, drummer's wife, keeper of a great many stories. When I was young I walked to the forests as an envoy, as the Brenna once did, and I kept a friend there.
    - I hosted the choosing that named him, after Varra died. A long night: argument, drumming, song. Hask said almost nothing, and that is why the families chose him. I advise him. Sometimes he even listens.
    - Four families, each proud as a mountain. I settle their quarrels with stories: I find one where both chieftains were right, and let them hear it together. It works more often than you'd think.
    - Go gently, *Player*. And come back for tea.
